import { expect, type Locator, type Page, test } from '@playwright/test'

// Runs in two projects (playwright.config.ts): desktop 1280px with a mouse, mobile 375px with touch.

const column = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => page.locator(`[data-column="${id}"]`)
const card = (page: Page, title: string) => page.locator('li[data-card-id]', { has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: title, exact: true }) })
const titlesIn = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => column(page, id).locator('li[data-card-id] h3').allTextContents()

async function addCard(page: Page, col: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', title: string, opts: { description?: string; due?: string; priority?: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' } = {}) {
  await column(page, col).getByRole('button', { name: /^Add card to/ }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
  await dialog.getByLabel('Title').fill(title)
  if (opts.description) await dialog.getByLabel(/Description/).fill(opts.description)
  if (opts.due) await dialog.getByLabel(/Due date/).fill(opts.due)
  if (opts.priority) await dialog.getByText(opts.priority, { exact: true }).click()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
}

/** Drags with the mouse on desktop and with real touch events on mobile (via CDP). */
async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, to: Locator, where: 'top' | 'bottom' = 'top', isMobile = false) {
  await from.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  const handle = isMobile ? from.locator('[data-grip]') : from.locator('h3')
  const a = (await handle.boundingBox())!
  const b0 = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const sx = a.x + a.width / 2
  const sy = a.y + a.height / 2
  const tx = b0.x + b0.width / 2
  const ty = where === 'top' ? b0.y + 4 : b0.y + b0.height - 4
  if (!isMobile) {
    await page.mouse.move(sx, sy)
    await page.mouse.down()
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) await page.mouse.move(sx + ((tx - sx) * i) / 12, sy + ((ty - sy) * i) / 12)
    await page.mouse.up()
    return
  }
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page)
  const touch = (type: string, x: number, y: number) =>
    cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type, touchPoints: type === 'touchEnd' ? [] : [{ x, y }] })
  const vh = page.viewportSize()!.height
  await touch('touchStart', sx, sy)
  // If the target is off-screen, hold the finger near the edge so the app auto-scrolls to it.
  const cx = sx
  let cy = sy
  const SAFE = 70 // outside the app's 64px auto-scroll zone
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries++) {
    const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
    if (b.y + b.height > SAFE + 20 && b.y < vh - SAFE - 20) break // enough of the target is visible
    cy = b.y >= vh - SAFE - 20 ? vh - 20 : 20
    await touch('touchMove', cx, cy)
    await page.waitForTimeout(30)
  }
  const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const gx = b.x + b.width / 2
  const want = where === 'top' ? b.y + 4 : b.y + b.height - 4
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(want, SAFE, b.y + 2), vh - SAFE, b.y + b.height - 2)
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) await touch('touchMove', cx + ((gx - cx) * i) / 8, cy + ((gy - cy) * i) / 8)
  await touch('touchEnd', gx, gy)
  await cdp.detach()
}

  // Title is required.
  await column(page, 'todo').getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card to To do' }).click()
  await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card' }).click()

  const labelBg = await c.locator('.prio-high').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor)

test('drag between columns and reorder within a column', async ({ page }, info) => {
  const mobile = info.project.name === 'mobile'
  await addCard(page, 'todo', 'A')
  await addCard(page, 'todo', 'B')
  await addCard(page, 'todo', 'C')

  // Reorder: drag C to the top of To do.
  await dragTo(page, card(page, 'C'), card(page, 'A'), 'top', mobile)
  await expect.poll(() => titlesIn(page, 'todo')).toEqual(['C', 'A', 'B'])

  // Reorder: drag C to below B.
  await dragTo(page, card(page, 'C'), card(page, 'B'), 'bottom', mobile)
  await expect.poll(() => titlesIn(page, 'todo')).toEqual(['A', 'B', 'C'])

  // Move to another column (empty In progress).
  await dragTo(page, card(page, 'A'), column(page, 'doing'), 'bottom', mobile)
  await expect.poll(() => titlesIn(page, 'doing')).toEqual(['A'])
  await expect.poll(() => titlesIn(page, 'todo')).toEqual(['B', 'C'])

  // Drop before an existing card in another column.
  await dragTo(page, card(page, 'C'), card(page, 'A'), 'top', mobile)
  await expect.poll(() => titlesIn(page, 'doing')).toEqual(['C', 'A'])
  await expect(page.getByTestId('count-doing')).toContainText('2')

const column = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => page.locator(`[data-column="${id}"]`)

const titlesIn = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => column(page, id).locator('li[data-card-id] h3').allTextContents()

async function addCard(page: Page, col: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', title: string, opts: { description?: string; due?: string; priority?: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' } = {}) {
  await column(page, col).getByRole('button', { name: /^Add card to/ }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
  await dialog.getByLabel('Title').fill(title)
  if (opts.description) await dialog.getByLabel(/Description/).fill(opts.description)
  if (opts.due) await dialog.getByLabel(/Due date/).fill(opts.due)
  if (opts.priority) await dialog.getByText(opts.priority, { exact: true }).click()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card' }).click()

}

/** Drags with the mouse on desktop and with real touch events on mobile (via CDP). */
async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, to: Locator, where: 'top' | 'bottom' = 'top', isMobile = false) {
  await from.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  const handle = isMobile ? from.locator('[data-grip]') : from.locator('h3')
  const a = (await handle.boundingBox())!
  const b0 = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const sx = a.x + a.width / 2
  const sy = a.y + a.height / 2
  const tx = b0.x + b0.width / 2
  const ty = where === 'top' ? b0.y + 4 : b0.y + b0.height - 4
  if (!isMobile) {
    await page.mouse.move(sx, sy)
    await page.mouse.down()
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) await page.mouse.move(sx + ((tx - sx) * i) / 12, sy + ((ty - sy) * i) / 12)
    await page.mouse.up()
    return
  }
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page)
  const touch = (type: string, x: number, y: number) =>
    cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type, touchPoints: type === 'touchEnd' ? [] : [{ x, y }] })
  const vh = page.viewportSize()!.height
  await touch('touchStart', sx, sy)
  // If the target is off-screen, hold the finger near the edge so the app auto-scrolls to it.
  const cx = sx
  let cy = sy
  const SAFE = 70 // outside the app's 64px auto-scroll zone
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries++) {
    const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
    if (b.y + b.height > SAFE + 20 && b.y < vh - SAFE - 20) break // enough of the target is visible
    cy = b.y >= vh - SAFE - 20 ? vh - 20 : 20
    await touch('touchMove', cx, cy)
    await page.waitForTimeout(30)
  }
  const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const gx = b.x + b.width / 2
  const want = where === 'top' ? b.y + 4 : b.y + b.height - 4
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(want, SAFE, b.y + 2), vh - SAFE, b.y + b.height - 2)
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) await touch('touchMove', cx + ((gx - cx) * i) / 8, cy + ((gy - cy) * i) / 8)
  await touch('touchEnd', gx, gy)
  await cdp.detach()
}

import { expect, type Locator, type Page, test } from '@playwright/test'

// Runs in two projects (playwright.config.ts): desktop 1280px with a mouse, mobile 375px with touch.

const column = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => page.locator(`[data-column="${id}"]`)
const card = (page: Page, title: string) => page.locator('li[data-card-id]', { has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: title, exact: true }) })
const titlesIn = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => column(page, id).locator('li[data-card-id] h3').allTextContents()

async function addCard(page: Page, col: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', title: string, opts: { description?: string; due?: string; priority?: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' } = {}) {
  await column(page, col).getByRole('button', { name: /^Add card to/ }).click()

  await dialog.getByLabel('Title').fill(title)
  if (opts.description) await dialog.getByLabel(/Description/).fill(opts.description)
  if (opts.due) await dialog.getByLabel(/Due date/).fill(opts.due)

/** Drags with the mouse on desktop and with real touch events on mobile (via CDP). */
async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, to: Locator, where: 'top' | 'bottom' = 'top', isMobile = false) {
  await from.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  const handle = isMobile ? from.locator('[data-grip]') : from.locator('h3')
  const a = (await handle.boundingBox())!
  const b0 = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const sx = a.x + a.width / 2
  const sy = a.y + a.height / 2
  const tx = b0.x + b0.width / 2
  const ty = where === 'top' ? b0.y + 4 : b0.y + b0.height - 4
  if (!isMobile) {
    await page.mouse.move(sx, sy)
    await page.mouse.down()
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) await page.mouse.move(sx + ((tx - sx) * i) / 12, sy + ((ty - sy) * i) / 12)
    await page.mouse.up()
    return
  }
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page)
  const touch = (type: string, x: number, y: number) =>
    cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type, touchPoints: type === 'touchEnd' ? [] : [{ x, y }] })
  const vh = page.viewportSize()!.height
  await touch('touchStart', sx, sy)
  // If the target is off-screen, hold the finger near the edge so the app auto-scrolls to it.
  const cx = sx
  let cy = sy
  const SAFE = 70 // outside the app's 64px auto-scroll zone
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries++) {
    const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
    if (b.y + b.height > SAFE + 20 && b.y < vh - SAFE - 20) break // enough of the target is visible
    cy = b.y >= vh - SAFE - 20 ? vh - 20 : 20
    await touch('touchMove', cx, cy)
    await page.waitForTimeout(30)
  }
  const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const gx = b.x + b.width / 2
  const want = where === 'top' ? b.y + 4 : b.y + b.height - 4
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(want, SAFE, b.y + 2), vh - SAFE, b.y + b.height - 2)
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) await touch('touchMove', cx + ((gx - cx) * i) / 8, cy + ((gy - cy) * i) / 8)
  await touch('touchEnd', gx, gy)
  await cdp.detach()
}

import { expect, type Locator, type Page, test } from '@playwright/test'

// Runs in two projects (playwright.config.ts): desktop 1280px with a mouse, mobile 375px with touch.

const column = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => page.locator(`[data-column="${id}"]`)
const card = (page: Page, title: string) => page.locator('li[data-card-id]', { has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: title, exact: true }) })
const titlesIn = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => column(page, id).locator('li[data-card-id] h3').allTextContents()

async function addCard(page: Page, col: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', title: string, opts: { description?: string; due?: string; priority?: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' } = {}) {
  await column(page, col).getByRole('button', { name: /^Add card to/ }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
  await dialog.getByLabel('Title').fill(title)
  if (opts.description) await dialog.getByLabel(/Description/).fill(opts.description)
  if (opts.due) await dialog.getByLabel(/Due date/).fill(opts.due)
  if (opts.priority) await dialog.getByText(opts.priority, { exact: true }).click()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
}

/** Opens a card's "⋯" menu and picks an item. */
async function cardAction(page: Page, title: string, item: string) {
  await card(page, title).getByRole('button', { name: `Actions for “${title}”` }).click()
  await page.getByRole('menu').getByRole('menuitem', { name: item }).click()
}

/** Switches boards by name (option labels also carry a card count). */
async function switchTo(page: Page, name: string) {
  const value = await page.locator('#board-select option').filter({ hasText: new RegExp(`^${name} \\(\\d+\\)$`) }).getAttribute('value')
  await page.getByLabel('Current board').selectOption(value!)
}

async function createBoard(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New board' }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'New board' })
  await dialog.getByLabel('Board name').fill(name)
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create board' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
}

const currentBoard = (page: Page) => page.getByLabel('Current board').evaluate((s: HTMLSelectElement) => s.selectedOptions[0].textContent)

/** Drags with the mouse on desktop and with real touch events on mobile (via CDP). */
async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, to: Locator, where: 'top' | 'bottom' = 'top', isMobile = false) {
  await from.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  const handle = isMobile ? from.locator('[data-grip]') : from.locator('h3')
  const a = (await handle.boundingBox())!
  const b0 = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const sx = a.x + a.width / 2
  const sy = a.y + a.height / 2
  const tx = b0.x + b0.width / 2
  const ty = where === 'top' ? b0.y + 4 : b0.y + b0.height - 4
  if (!isMobile) {
    await page.mouse.move(sx, sy)
    await page.mouse.down()
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) await page.mouse.move(sx + ((tx - sx) * i) / 12, sy + ((ty - sy) * i) / 12)
    await page.mouse.up()
    return
  }
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page)
  const touch = (type: string, x: number, y: number) =>
    cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type, touchPoints: type === 'touchEnd' ? [] : [{ x, y }] })
  const vh = page.viewportSize()!.height
  await touch('touchStart', sx, sy)
  // If the target is off-screen, hold the finger near the edge so the app auto-scrolls to it.
  const cx = sx
  let cy = sy
  const SAFE = 70 // outside the app's 64px auto-scroll zone
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries++) {
    const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
    if (b.y + b.height > SAFE + 20 && b.y < vh - SAFE - 20) break // enough of the target is visible
    cy = b.y >= vh - SAFE - 20 ? vh - 20 : 20
    await touch('touchMove', cx, cy)
    await page.waitForTimeout(30)
  }
  const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const gx = b.x + b.width / 2
  const want = where === 'top' ? b.y + 4 : b.y + b.height - 4
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(want, SAFE, b.y + 2), vh - SAFE, b.y + b.height - 2)
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) await touch('touchMove', cx + ((gx - cx) * i) / 8, cy + ((gy - cy) * i) / 8)
  await touch('touchEnd', gx, gy)
  await cdp.detach()
}

import { expect, type Locator, type Page, test } from '@playwright/test'

// Runs in two projects (playwright.config.ts): desktop 1280px with a mouse, mobile 375px with touch.

const column = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => page.locator(`[data-column="${id}"]`)
const card = (page: Page, title: string) => page.locator('li[data-card-id]', { has: page.getByRole('heading', { name: title, exact: true }) })
const titlesIn = (page: Page, id: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done') => column(page, id).locator('li[data-card-id] h3').allTextContents()

async function addCard(page: Page, col: 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', title: string, opts: { description?: string; due?: string; priority?: 'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High' } = {}) {
  await column(page, col).getByRole('button', { name: /^Add card to/ }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
  await dialog.getByLabel('Title').fill(title)
  if (opts.description) await dialog.getByLabel(/Description/).fill(opts.description)
  if (opts.due) await dialog.getByLabel(/Due date/).fill(opts.due)
  if (opts.priority) await dialog.getByText(opts.priority, { exact: true }).click()
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add card' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
}

/** Opens a card's "⋯" menu and picks an item. */
async function cardAction(page: Page, title: string, item: string) {
  await card(page, title).getByRole('button', { name: `Actions for “${title}”` }).click()
  await page.getByRole('menu').getByRole('menuitem', { name: item }).click()
}

/** Switches boards by name (option labels also carry a card count). */
async function switchTo(page: Page, name: string) {
  const value = await page.locator('#board-select option').filter({ hasText: new RegExp(`^${name} \\(\\d+\\)$`) }).getAttribute('value')
  await page.getByLabel('Current board').selectOption(value!)
}

async function createBoard(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'New board' }).click()
  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'New board' })
  await dialog.getByLabel('Board name').fill(name)
  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Create board' }).click()
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden()
}

const currentBoard = (page: Page) => page.getByLabel('Current board').evaluate((s: HTMLSelectElement) => s.selectedOptions[0].textContent)

/** Drags with the mouse on desktop and with real touch events on mobile (via CDP). */
async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, to: Locator, where: 'top' | 'bottom' = 'top', isMobile = false) {
  await from.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
  const handle = isMobile ? from.locator('[data-grip]') : from.locator('h3')
  const a = (await handle.boundingBox())!
  const b0 = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const sx = a.x + a.width / 2
  const sy = a.y + a.height / 2
  const tx = b0.x + b0.width / 2
  const ty = where === 'top' ? b0.y + 4 : b0.y + b0.height - 4
  if (!isMobile) {
    await page.mouse.move(sx, sy)
    await page.mouse.down()
    for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) await page.mouse.move(sx + ((tx - sx) * i) / 12, sy + ((ty - sy) * i) / 12)
    await page.mouse.up()
    return
  }
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page)
  const touch = (type: string, x: number, y: number) =>
    cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type, touchPoints: type === 'touchEnd' ? [] : [{ x, y }] })
  const vh = page.viewportSize()!.height
  await touch('touchStart', sx, sy)
  // If the target is off-screen, hold the finger near the edge so the app auto-scrolls to it.
  const cx = sx
  let cy = sy
  const SAFE = 70 // outside the app's 64px auto-scroll zone
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 200; tries++) {
    const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
    if (b.y + b.height > SAFE + 20 && b.y < vh - SAFE - 20) break // enough of the target is visible
    cy = b.y >= vh - SAFE - 20 ? vh - 20 : 20
    await touch('touchMove', cx, cy)
    await page.waitForTimeout(30)
  }
  const b = (await to.boundingBox())!
  const gx = b.x + b.width / 2
  const want = where === 'top' ? b.y + 4 : b.y + b.height - 4
  const gy = Math.min(Math.max(want, SAFE, b.y + 2), vh - SAFE, b.y + b.height - 2)
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) await touch('touchMove', cx + ((gx - cx) * i) / 8, cy + ((gy - cy) * i) / 8)
  await touch('touchEnd', gx, gy)
  await cdp.detach()
}

The app now has multiple boards, and a board saved by the old version opens as the first board, "My board", with every card in place. **Board switcher** (header, next to the title): a board dropdown with New, Rename and Delete buttons. The buttons have text labels at desktop width and are icon-only at 375px.
- **Create:** the new board starts empty and becomes the current board.
- **Rename:** the name box is pre-filled with the current name.
- **Names:** a name is required, at most 60 characters, and can't match another board's name, ignoring case.
- **Delete:** asks first, naming the board and how many cards will go with it. When only one board is left, the Delete button is disabled with a tooltip, and the logic refuses to delete it anyway.
- After you delete the board you're on, the app switches to the next board, or the previous one if it was last.
- The dropdown shows each board's card count, and the browser tab title shows the board name.

**Each board is separate:** it has its own three columns and cards. The WIP warning and empty states apply per board. The current board is remembered across reloads.

**Card menu:** each card now has a "⋯" menu with Edit, Move to board… and Delete. This replaces the separate edit and delete icons, so deleting a card now takes two clicks. Clicking the card still edits it, and the Delete key still asks for confirmation. You can open and navigate the menu with the arrow keys and close it with Escape.
- **Move to board…** lists your other boards and lets you pick the column, which defaults to the card's current one. The card is added at the end of that column with all its fields and you stay on the board you were on.
- With only one board, the item is greyed out and says "Create another board first".

**Old saved data:** boards are now saved under a new storage key. The first time it runs, the app copies the old single board into "My board", keeping the card order. The old key is left untouched, so going back to the earlier version still works. If the new data is ever unreadable, the app first saves a copy of it under a backup key, then falls back to the old board.

  - Boards staying independent; moving a card to another board, a chosen column, an unknown card or board, and the rare case of a duplicate card ID.
  - Loading and conversion: old data becoming "My board" with nothing lost, newer data taking priority over old, unreadable data being backed up first, storage that throws errors, and repairing broken saved data.
- **In real Chrome, 1280px with a mouse and 375px with touch:** the 11 existing tests, updated to delete through the card menu, plus 5 new ones.
  - Old saved data, including an overdue card and 4 cards in progress, opens intact and survives a reload. The old key is unchanged.
  - Full board create, switch, rename and delete flow: validation messages, Cancel and Escape, the delete confirmation text, the disabled last-board Delete, where focus lands, and reload.
  - Move to board…: greyed out with one board, then mouse and keyboard menu use, picking a board and column, Cancel, the card's data, the screen-reader announcement, and reload.
  - The card menu closing on Escape or a click outside without opening the editor.
  - The WIP warning and search applying per board.
- **By eye:** I looked at screenshots of the converted board, the switcher, the card menu and the Move to board dialog at both widths. Layout held and nothing scrolled sideways.
